lines.text: One small feature takes ten steps, eight tools, and hours of coordination.
Most of it isn't judgment. It's busywork.
Meet AAVA 3.0: an agentic assistant that starts the work before you do.
It picks up your tickets, and pulls context from the tools you already use.
By the time you look, the work is built, tested, and ready for review.
And when a decision is yours, it stops, and asks. Never earlier. Never later.
Ten steps become a few. All in one place.
AAVA does the heavy lifting. You make the decisions.
